annotation.bound_parties_text: The Act imposes duties on the Secretary of State, authorised self-driving entities, licensed no-user-in-charge operators and other regulated bodies (including nominated individuals and senior managers), and users-in-charge.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: A regulated body commits an offence if it— fails to provide information as required by an information notice
annotation.dates_quote: S. 94  in force at Royal Assent, see s. 99(3)
annotation.robot_provision_quote: An Act to regulate the use of automated vehicles on roads and in other public places; and to make other provision in relation to vehicle automation.
